basis: Disordered fetal brain growth causes microcephaly and usually intellectual disability; short stature alone does not establish skeletal disease.
Inherited absence of tuberculin-specific delayed hypersensitivity is an immune-response phenotype; no evidence establishes infection or other organ injury.
Congenital megakaryocyte deficiency causes thrombocytopenia and commonly progresses to hypocellular marrow failure and pancytopenia.
Isolated failure of sperm production affects reproductive function; endocrine gland dysfunction is not established.
Immune-mediated epidermal necrosis; oral erosions in >80%, ocular surface dysfunction in 30-79%; airway injury omitted at cap; renal injury <30%.
Umbrella skeletal dysplasia involving vertebrae and metaphyses; additional organ abnormalities are subtype-specific.
Inflammatory engraftment reaction with defining pulmonary capillary leak and deterioration; fever and transient rash do not establish additional organ damage.
Carcinoma originates in the uterus, a reproductive organ outside the defined axes.
Congenital erythrocytosis; thrombosis is a separate complication. Pulmonary hypertension reported in 1 patient does not establish a population frequency of >=30%.
Immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease causing epidermal atrophy and dermal sclerosis; genital skin remains dermatologic.
Melanoma originates in the skin; metastatic sites are not defining organ involvement.
Squamous carcinoma originates in the larynx, which belongs to the airway axis.
Infiltrative fibrofatty neoplasm of extremity connective tissue, typically involving subcutaneous fat and fibrous soft tissue.
Malignant neoplasm of hepatic vascular endothelium; hepatic location and vascular origin define the disease.
Familial adrenal glucocorticoid deficiency; hyperpigmentation in 5/7 reflects hormonal stimulation rather than skin damage.
Benign vascular tumour composed of cavernous vascular channels; no specific organ location or common blood-cell disorder is established.
Elevated intraocular pressure is an eye disorder; it is not systemic arterial hypertension.
Hereditary cerebral amyloid metabolism disorder causes neurodegeneration and vascular deposition; hearing loss 30-79%; cataracts 30-79% omitted at cap.
Carcinoma originates in the hard palate within the oral cavity.
Nonsyndromic inherited hearing loss; no additional organ disease is established.
Bacterial infection involving lymph nodes; lymphadenitis does not establish blood-cell or marrow disease.
Inherited digital skeletal dysplasia with brachydactyly and progressive small-joint arthropathy in essentially all reported patients.
Intellectual disability and growth hormone deficiency are defining; structural brain and ocular motor findings are occasional and add no separate axis.
Inherited defects of hepatic bilirubin processing or excretion; neurologic injury and other systemic damage are restricted to particular severe subtypes.
Peptic ulceration of the gastrojejunal region; hemorrhage and perforation do not establish another directly affected organ axis.
